city.why.northernValley.title: Why {{name}} gets so smoky
city.why.northernValley.p1: In the dry season, fires are detected across the region, and smoke can collect in a valley city: the mountains around it and cool, still air keep the smoke close to the ground.
city.why.northernValley.p2: Fahsai puts the three pieces side by side: where fires have been detected, which way the wind carried the air, and what the stations measured.
